'''List of Wars''' is the extracted Avantpedia source index for major conflicts.

== 1994-Back Entries ==

The 1994-back pass preserves the source index as a timeline aid, not as a final audited war catalogue. The relevant entries are:

* [[Avant Great War]]: 1937-1949.
* [[Volgastani-Osman War]]: 1969-1973.
* [[Svet-Orinan War]]: 1973-1975.
* [[Mariposian Civil War]]: 1975-1981.
* [[Volgastani-Hanovkayan War]]: 1989-1998, with only the 1989-1994 phase covered in this pass.
* [[Solara-Khalindar War]]: 1990-1994, listed in the old source as Avant World War.

== Excluded Later Entries ==

The source also lists later conflicts such as Mariposian Wars, Zhensanov Continuation War, and Second Astorian-Mariposia War. Those belong to a later post-1994 pass unless they are needed as immediate aftermath notes.

== Source Limits ==

The old list often gives only titles and dates. Individual conflict pages should control causes, combatants, casualties, outcomes, and territorial effects once those facts are audited.
